newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-BOCA HEAD FOR CRISIS AFTER ANOTHER DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOCA HEAD FOR CRISIS AFTER ANOTHER DEFEAT.

text.p: Velez Sarsfield goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert converted another penalty to send Boca Juniors, Argentina's most popular club, sliding towards another crisis on Sunday.
Paraguayan international Chilavert, who has become the regular free-kick and penalty taker for both his club and country, equalised in the 43rd minute after Boca had taken an early lead.
A goal nine minutes from the end by striker Claudio Moriggi Velez a 2-1 away win and left Boca, whose fans have become used to mid-table mediocrity in the last few years, in 13th place.
Boca were jeered off the pitch after losing against opponents who played with ten men from the 20th minute, when Claudio Husain was sent off.
Unfashionable Colon, who have never won a major title, stayed top of the Clausura championship by beating San Lorenzo 1-0.
River Plate, early leaders of the competition, appeared to still be pining for midfielder Ariel Ortega, who was sold to Spanish club Valencia last month.
Their performances have declined significantly since Ortega's departure and on Sunday they needed a goal from 35- year-old Uruguayan veteran Enzo Francescoli to force a 1-1 draw with Gimnasia-Jujuy.

River, who looked unstoppable as they won their first four games in the tournament, have taken only five points from a possible nine since Ortega's departure and have slipped to third, although with a game in hand over Colon.
The Clausura is the second of the two competitions played in the Argentine season. River won the first tournament, known as the Apertura.
